description: Asked where the news was heard, and believed only that far.
name: Alice Brambleby

description: Kept the groom's facts apart from the growing talk.
name: George Bryan

description: Kept to books he can show, and had not seen the new one.
name: John Harrison

description: Asked for the short version, and did not name the play.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Had not seen it either, and would not own a title he had not printed.
name: Richard Field

description: Heard the title, looked at Burbage, and said nothing of his own books.
name: William Shakespeare
